problemRelevance.UP-605: The sealed L0002 interval is a within-domain test of whether a source-calibrated temporal detector remains valid under a later process regime. Its failure is a bounded external-validity result, not a semiconductor-fab transfer claim.
problemRelevance.UP-315: Synthetic omissions and natural transitions form competing histories with overlapping image evidence. The result is a concrete non-identification example, not a universal finite-measurement impossibility theorem.

confirmedFacts: The authenticated L0002 AVI contains 95,504 lossless 120 by 120 frames and was deterministically area-resampled to a 97,796,096-byte 32 by 32 gray stream with SHA-256 6bfe5a05a9825344bfa84f380a42d16b486885030429dba8818093d0b5b69df1.
Five model families, four gap lengths, all split boundaries, deterministic injection positions, thresholds, and hard gates were committed before any RC47 pixel or score was inspected.
Validation selected scalar-jump for block lengths 1, 4, and 8 and ridge-LDA-1.0 for block length 2.
On the untouched final 19,101 frames, singleton recall is 0; block-2, block-4, and block-8 recall are 3.90625%, 4.6875%, and 7.03125%.
All 640 injected trials make a call, 620 calls are false, aggregate FDR is 96.875%, and each of four unmodified controls produces a false call.
Python and Node independently agree on every truth and call, all selected families, and the final decision with maximum numeric difference 7.11e-15.
The dominant scalar-model false alarm at ordinal 77,596 coincides with a 99.997th-percentile command-position jump only under an unauthenticated count-equal ordinal mapping.
The block-2 maximum at ordinal 92,905 has a 99.985th-percentile image transition but an ordinary mapped command step, so command jump filtering alone is insufficient.
inferences: The fixed image-only cadence families do not separate one-to-eight-frame omissions from natural L0002 transitions at whole-partition false-alarm control.
The source and target intervals are nonstationary enough that a validation-maximum threshold is not transportable even within one layer.
A state-conditioned model would need an independently timed state channel and a new untouched outcome block; post hoc removal of ordinals 77,596 or 92,905 would be selection leakage.
Because no RC47 error rule passes, image scores safely exclude none of L0001's possible missing-position histories.
unverifiedProposals: Recover a laboratory-held MotionBLITZ tick or exposure ledger and bind it cryptographically to the public AVI; direct identity would supersede image inference.
If no ledger exists, preregister a regime-boundary state model using independently calibrated DAQ timing, test it on a new layer, and make abstention—not forced localization—the primary output.
Generalize the count-only equivalence bound into an identifiability budget that quantifies how verified anchors and timing bits shrink possible histories.

minimumAdvance.empirical: A preregistered negative result prevents further image acquisition for a detector family that fails even within its development layer.
minimumAdvance.theoretical: Under exactly 23 arbitrary order-preserving omissions among 94,736 triggers, count-only evidence leaves choose(94,736,23), about 2^305.77, missing sets and therefore requires at least 306 aggregate discriminating bits under that model.

failedAttempt.description: Multiscale pair jumps, tail-area changes, projection changes, scalar scores, diagonal LDA, and three ridge-LDA strengths were unable to dominate natural regime boundaries in the sealed block.
failedAttempt.resolution: No threshold or family was changed. The route is rejected and the outcome-aware regime diagnostic is labeled exploratory.

uncertainty.measurement: The public AVI lacks authenticated exposure ticks; 32 by 32 gray conversion discards color and fine spatial information.
uncertainty.model: The fixed families do not include a learned optical-flow or physical thermal-state model, so failure does not exclude every image method.
uncertainty.sampling: Training, validation, and sealed testing all use one L0002 layer; the result has no independent-layer transport estimate.
uncertainty.externalValidity: An additive-manufacturing camera stream is only a structural test for UP-605 and UP-315, not a semiconductor-yield or arbitrary-replication experiment.
uncertainty.implementation: Independent implementations share the same FFmpeg-derived bytes, feature specification, and source AVI.
uncertainty.postGate: Associations between false alarms and mapped commands are exploratory because the diagnostic was designed after viewing outcomes and ordinal pairing is not authenticated.

nextCycleStart: Prioritize a provenance and identifiability cycle rather than another outcome-tuned image detector. Recheck the public record and primary papers for MotionBLITZ .dat/.exp, exposure ticks, trigger logs, or archive revisions; specify the byte-level evidence needed to bind any recovered sidecar to the AVI. In parallel, preregister how one verified anchor, periodic authenticated timestamps, and a monotonic counter shrink the 2^305.77 count-only history class. Only if an independently timed state channel and a new untouched layer are available should a regime-conditioned deletion detector be attempted; L0001 remains sealed.
